input.command:
cd D:\npqo
$p = 'src\components\AgentCard.tsx'
$t = Get-Content -Raw $p
$t = $t.Replace('agent-card tone-${agent.accent} tone-text-${agent.tone}', 'agent-card accent-${agent.accent} value-tone-${agent.tone}')
Set-Content -Path $p -Value $t -NoNewline -Encoding ascii
$p = 'src\components\EquityPanel.tsx'
$t = Get-Content -Raw $p
$t = $t.Replace('import { useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";', 'import { useId, useMemo, useState, type PointerEvent } from "react";')
$t = $t.Replace('event: React.PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>', 'event: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>')
$t = $t -replace '\{up \? "[^"]*" : "[^"]*"\}', '{up ? "UP" : "DN"}'
Set-Content -Path $p -Value $t -NoNewline -Encoding ascii
npm run build
